div.div: p0 = BC slave port, p1 = BC master port (same NIC), p2 = grandmaster. The grandmaster must be on the BC slave port's LAN so that PTP sync works over a direct connection (or a plain, non-BC switch). The BC master port has no downstream slave in this minimal scenario.
